import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the Issues page using the link from the accessibility tree
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Project navigation").get_by_role("link", name="Issues", exact=True)
    await issues_link.click()
    await asyncio.sleep(5)  # Wait for the page to load
    
    # After navigation, apply filters for opened issues without labels
    # First, try to find and set status filter to 'Open'
    status_filter = page.get_by_role("button", name="Status", exact=False).or_(page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status", exact=False))
    if await status_filter.count() > 0:
        await status_filter.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        open_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Open", exact=True)
        if await open_option.count() > 0:
            await open_option.click()
        else:
            # If 'Open' option not found, maybe it's already selected or not available
            pass
    else:
        # If no status filter found, assume issues are already filtered or not needed
        pass
    
    # Next, apply filter for no labels
    label_filter = page.get_by_role("button", name="Label", exact=False).or_(page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Label", exact=False))
    if await label_filter.count() > 0:
        await label_filter.click()
        await asyncio.sleep(2)
        no_label_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="No label", exact=True).or_(page.get_by_role("option", name="None", exact=True))
        if await no_label_option.count() > 0:
            await no_label_option.click()
        else:
            # If no such option, try to clear labels or input 'None'
            pass
    else:
        # If no label filter, assume all issues are shown
        pass
    
    # Wait for filters to apply
    await asyncio.sleep(5)
    
    # Extract the list of issues from the page
    # Look for issue items, commonly with role 'listitem' or 'article' in GitLab
    issues = []
    issue_elements = page.get_by_role("listitem").or_(page.get_by_role("article"))
    count = await issue_elements.count()
    for i in range(count):
        issue = issue_elements.nth(i)
        text = await issue.text_content()
        issues.append(text.strip())
    
    # Return the result as a string
    result = '\n'.join(issues) if issues else "No opened issues without labels found."
    return result
